products.subtitle: Folds to keychain size — opens into a full tote
products.descriptionHtml:
Nylon canvas, a keychain-sized fold, and a full shopping bag's worth of capacity the moment you shake it open. Built for the errand you didn't plan for — the extra grocery run, the gift that needs carrying, the gym bag that overflowed.

Reinforced seams and a durable weave mean this is a bag meant to be unfolded and refolded hundreds of times, not a disposable liner. Dual handles are sized for a comfortable grip by hand or over a shoulder, and it folds back down small enough to clip to a keyring, bag strap, or belt loop.

Available in Khaki, Red, Coffee, Black, Green, and White — every colorway is the same reinforced build underneath. Ships as one tote bag per order.

specs.label: Material
specs.description: A durable woven nylon built to be folded and unfolded daily without stretching out or splitting at the seams.

specs.label: Folded size
specs.description: Folds along its seams into a pouch small enough to clip to a keyring, bag strap, or belt loop.

specs.label: Capacity
specs.description: Opens into a wide, full-capacity tote with dual handles sized for a comfortable grip, by hand or over the shoulder.

specs.label: Colors
specs.value: Khaki, Red, Coffee, Black, Green, White
specs.description: Six colorways on the same reinforced build, so you can match it to how you'll actually use it.

specs.label: Construction
specs.description: Stitched seams and a durable weave hold up to daily shopping runs, commutes, and gym trips.

specs.label: Best for
specs.description: Built for the errand you did not plan for — the extra grocery run, the gift that needs carrying, the overflowing gym bag.

features.label: Folds to keychain size
features.body: Collapses down small enough to clip to a keyring or bag strap — it travels with you, ready before you need it.

features.label: Opens to a full-size tote
features.body: Reinforced nylon holds its shape under load, wide enough for a grocery haul.

perks: Great for shopping, errands, gym, travel
Clips to a keyring, bag strap or belt loop
Dual handles for hand or shoulder carry
